keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Seattle Sounders FC 1, Los Angeles Football Club 0. Albert Rusnák (Seattle Sounders FC) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Cristian Roldan.
Delay in match because of an injury Jordan Morris (Seattle Sounders FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Jesús Ferreira replaces Jordan Morris because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Sebastian Gomez (Seattle Sounders FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Seattle Sounders FC 2, Los Angeles Football Club 0. Sebastian Gomez (Seattle Sounders FC) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Albert Rusnák.
Second Half begins Seattle Sounders FC 2, Los Angeles Football Club 0.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Paul Arriola replaces Sebastian Gomez.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Snyder Brunell replaces Albert Rusnák.
Substitution, Los Angeles Football Club. Jacob Shaffelburg replaces Armindo Sieb.
Sergi Palencia (Los Angeles Football Club) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jackson Ragen (Seattle Sounders FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Jacob Shaffelburg (Los Angeles Football Club).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Los Angeles Football Club. Tyler Boyd replaces Jacob Shaffelburg because of an injury.

Goal! Seattle Sounders FC 2, Los Angeles Football Club 1. Eddie Segura (Los Angeles Football Club) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Ryan Porteous with a headed pass following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Paul Rothrock replaces Dejan Joveljic.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Peter Kingston replaces Cristian Roldan.
Substitution, Los Angeles Football Club. Jeremy Ebobisse replaces Mathieu Choinière.
Kalani Kossa-Rienzi (Seattle Sounders FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Peter Kingston (Seattle Sounders FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Seattle Sounders FC 2, Los Angeles Football Club 1.
